name: gemini-discord
description: Discord bridge for Gemini CLI / ACP agent workflows

settings.name: Discord Bot Token
settings.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

settings.name: Boss Discord User ID
settings.description: Stable numeric Discord user ID for full bridge authority.

settings.name: Discord Server ID
settings.description: ID of the server where the bot is installed.

settings.name: Gemini API Key
settings.description: Recommended non-interactive Gemini API key for daemon child processes.

settings.name: Use Vertex AI
settings.description: Set to true to authenticate Gemini CLI child processes with Vertex AI.

settings.name: Google API Key
settings.description: Optional Google API key for Vertex AI auth when GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true.

settings.name: Google Cloud Project
settings.description: Optional Google Cloud project for Vertex AI auth.

settings.name: Google Cloud Location
settings.description: Optional Google Cloud location for Vertex AI auth.
